title: Top Desk Lamps for Eye Comfort (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the reviews on Tom’s Guide, Consumer Reports, PCMag, MGahv.in, Lighting Design Alliance, and Classic Tenders. Products mentioned by more than one source were prioritized.

verdict.line: Ideal for people who work long hours at a computer or read in dim light. It offers adjustable height, color temperature, and brightness, making it a versatile choice for most users. The main catch is that it requires a separate bulb.
